scope: Actual issue search/detail pages only. Eight recent open pages plus targeted searches and recently closed issues; this is not exhaustive issue coverage or a claim that every report reproduces in Kitsune. No pull-request search, review, comments or issue writes.
access: Normal supplied cloud proxy/certificate route and TLS verification. Prior task observed GitHub API403; this phase uses public GitHub embedded application JSON and does not extract or replace authentication. Raw issue bodies may contain operator content and remain private scratch; public receipt contains minimal metadata, hashes and curated technical summaries.
